'''Qor'thest''', known as '''Qor'thest the Guardian''', was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was a member of the [[Dread Host]], the armies of the [[Dread Masters]] during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Dread War]] on [[Oricon]], Qor'thest was among the defenders of the [[Dread Fortress]], but was [[Death/Legends|slain]] in battle.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Qor'thest the Guardian appears as a bonus named enemy in the Operation "The Dread Fortress," which was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' in Game Update 2.4.<ref name="TOR" />
